artworks.title: Queen Katherine's Dream [recto]
artworks.description: The image shows a preliminary sketch on lightly toned paper, featuring an incomplete penciled drawing of several figures. The sketch focuses on three individuals depicted in partial to full form. The first figure is an elderly man with a beard and simple cloaking. He is slightly hunched forward, suggesting a seated stance on an elevated section. Facing him is a partially sketched individual who appears to be kneeling or seated. The third person is a female figure in a reclining posture with facial outlines, long hair, draped clothing, and what appears to be jewelry. The figures are within a grid system, and the background includes faint architectural elements like a tall window or pillar, indicating an unfinished preparatory work.

artworks.title: Los and His Spectre [verso]
artworks.description: The image shows a rough, unfinished sketch of a figure seated on a block or pedestal, facing left. The facial features are minimal, with soft curls or waves for hair. The body is outlined with sketchy lines and lacks detailed clothing. Vague outlines around the figure suggest a complex scene or structure, possibly with another form resembling wings. The background is plain with a grid layout, and no color or intricate details are included.

artworks.title: The Great Red Dragon and the Woman Clothed with the Sun
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with watercolor over graphite
artworks.description: A winged woman, painted with tones of pale and butter yellow, kneels on a rock and looks up at a winged, horned creature with steel-gray skin and a curling tail flying above her in this vertical, graphite and watercolor work on paper. The woman, her body facing us, takes up most of the bottom half of the composition, and the winged creature the top half. The woman’s long blond hair flies up around her upturned face like stylized rays of sunlight. Her arms are spread wide, wrists flexed so her palms face out, and her pale, apricot-colored wings curve up over her shoulders and tuck behind her in a heart shape. She rests on a crescent moon with the tips pointing upward, which, in turn, rests on a gray, squared rock. Mirroring her pose but flying so his body faces downward as his feet point away from us, the creature above the woman has a muscular, humanoid physique. His long tail curls to our left in three loops, and is shaded with pale maroon red. Ram’s horns curve up from inside a golden crown encircling the top of his head, which faces us. Upon closer inspection, several faces, drawn with graphite and filled with nickel-gray watercolor, are connected around the creature's neck and also look down in profile onto the woman. The profiles overlap and some of the heads have moss-green, curling horns. The tips of the flying creature's outstretched fingers and arms nearly touch the sides of the paper and his light, rose-colored bat-like wings extend off both sides and the top of the composition. The background behind the pair is dark gray with white zigzagging lines to the left and right of the woman. Faces also emerge from the ground, looking up from the lower right corner. The artist signed his initials in black paint near the lower left: “WB.”

artworks.title: Wat Tyler's Daughter
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a person's head and shoulders. The person is facing slightly to the left, with their head turned to the side and tilted upwards. The facial features are soft and rounded, with large eyes, a small nose, and a subtle smile. The hair is styled in an elaborate updo with waves and curls. The clothing is suggested by a faint line at the shoulders, and there are no visible accessories. The background is plain.

artworks.title: King Canute
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a man's upper torso and head. He has distinct facial features with eyebrows, a mustache, and a curly beard. His hair is styled and merges into an elaborate crown atop his head. The crown is detailed and extends upwards. The man wears a simple cloak over his shoulders. The background is plain, and the paper shows signs of aging.

artworks.title: King Edward
artworks.description: The image is a profile sketch of a person's head and upper neck. The person has a prominent nose, pronounced chin, slim upper lip, distinct eyebrow ridge, voluminous, curly hair, and small, tight curls forming a mustache and beard. The person is facing right and there is no clothing, jewelry, or background detail visible. There is some handwritten text at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: A Warring Angel [recto]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure extending one arm forward and holding a rod in the other hand. The sketch presents a figure in a dynamic pose with defined musculature. The figure is drawn in an anatomical style, with visible muscle definition and slight shading to indicate form. The wings are partially sketched. The drawing uses fine lines to outline the figure against the blank background.

artworks.title: Time's Triple Bow [recto]
artworks.description: The image features a collection of interwoven lines and shapes, with arcs and curved forms forming a dynamic composition.

artworks.title: Saint Augustine Converting King Ethelbert of Kent
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of several figures engaged in a seated discussion. Most figures are visible from their heads to either their waists or feet, with a focus on central figures. The central figure on the left has a long beard and appears seated, gesturing with one hand. Another figure in front of him, bald with pronounced facial features, leans forward. Surrounding figures are sketched lightly, with some only showing their heads and upper bodies. Their facial features vary from outlined to detailed expressions. All figures wear long robes. The background lacks detail, focusing on the figures themselves.

artworks.title: A Man Seen from Behind, Rising on Clouds
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person in a reclining position. The individual is facing away from the viewer, with their right arm extended outward and the left arm barely visible. Facial features are not detailed, and the person's hair is of medium length with strands falling to the sides. The clothing is not clearly defined, blending with the swirling lines in the drawing. The sketch is simple, lacking visible jewelry or objects. The background consists of unadorned, textured paper.

artworks.title: The Infant Hercules Throttling the Serpents
artworks.description: The sketch shows four figures positioned next to each other. There is a person to the left seated in a semi-reclined position with one hand on the ground and the other on a knee. In the center, a child is seated on a soft cushion or drapery, with arms slightly extended. To the right, two figures are depicted standing upright. The figures are drawn with minimal detailing, and there is a faint outline suggesting an indoor setting or structural form in the background.

artworks.title: Two Legs
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of the human lower body, focusing on the legs from the upper thigh down to the feet. The body is depicted in two positions: the left leg is in a frontal view, with the foot pointing slightly forward, while the right leg is at a slight angle, with the foot pointing more sideways. The drawing emphasizes musculature and bony structures with a minimal sketch style. There are no distinct facial features, hair, or clothing depicted in the drawing. The background is a plain paper surface with some visible spots and a handwritten annotation on the right side attributing the drawing to William Blake.

artworks.title: The Descent of Peace [recto]
artworks.dimensions:
overall (approximate): 31.3 × 23.2 cm (12 5/16 × 9 1/8 in.)
image (approximate): 23.5 × 15.5 cm (9 1/4 × 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting abstract figures and forms. The drawing features faint pencil sketches showing various figures in dynamic poses suggesting movement and emotion. One figure is in a dramatic arch at the top, while a group of figures is framed by an arched structure below. In the foreground, a reclining figure appears to observe or react to the central group. The scene feels ethereal and dreamlike, capturing a narrative and symbolic moment.

artworks.title: A Figure Ascending in a Glory of Clouds (?)
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and curvilinear shapes overlapping and intertwining. The composition has an abstract quality, with lines resembling loops and spirals. Some loops form circular figures resembling coiled springs or abstract floral motifs.

artworks.title: An Armed Man Spurning a Woman [recto]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several abstract shapes and figures on paper. It features delicate pencil lines forming abstract figures. At the top, a crescent shape is visible. The lines convey motion, with circular patterns on the left and small circular forms at the bottom. The drawing has a sense of lightness and fluidity, possibly representing forms and compositions in an expressive manner.

artworks.title: An Ascending Spiral of Figures [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a seated figure in an upright position on a chair or throne. The figure has long hair, subtle facial features with closed eyes, and a serene expression. They are wearing a flowing garment that extends to the ground, with their hands positioned outward from the body. The sketch is drawn with soft pencil lines on a plain background, emphasizing the figure in the composition.

artworks.title: Job and His Daughters
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch featuring a group of figures. The central figure is seated, facing forward with one arm raised. The figures have minimally defined facial features and loosely suggested hair. Their clothing is depicted with flowing lines, and there are no specific details about accessories or objects. The background is lightly sketched with some vertical lines that might indicate structures or an environment.

artworks.title: Lady Torrens and Family
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract arrangement of human-like figures. The drawing is composed of simplified, sketchy lines that loosely represent several human-like forms in a group setting. The central figure appears to hold a circular form. The additional figures are positioned around standing and seated, with their forms indicated by minimal line work. The figures lack distinct features, making the arrangement more focused on the composition and interaction suggested by their stances. The work bears a quick, gestural style that gives it a spontaneous and fluid quality.

artworks.title: Sketch for the Title-Page of the Engraved Illustrations to the Book of Job
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an illustration for "The Book of Job". The drawing features ornate text and a wreath-like motif with detailed sketches. The image depicts the words "ILLUSTRATIONS of The BOOK of JOB" with decorative, swirling lines and exaggerated capital letters. Below, there is a faint, intricate sketch of a wreath or crescent shape composed of swirling forms or figures. The edge of the crescent contains what appear to be wings or feathers.

artworks.title: John Linnell
artworks.description: The image shows a lightly sketched portrait of a person. The portrait is in profile, with the person facing right. Details include facial features like the eyes, nose, and mouth, along with short wavy hair. Faint outlines suggest clothing, possibly formal wear. There are no objects or jewelry visible. The background is blank, with some handwritten text on the right edge, which may be a date or signature.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.medium: pen and ink with wash over graphite

artworks.title: Job and His Family Restored to Prosperity
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor over graphite
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures and sheep under a tree in the style of William Blake. The image features a collection of figures arranged in an arc, each holding musical instruments like harps, lyres, and trumpets. The figures are painted in flowing robes, suggesting a harmonious gathering. The scene includes sleeping sheep in the foreground, and the night sky above with a crescent moon and a single star. The painting uses muted, watercolor-like tones.

artworks.title: Christ Disputing with the Doctors
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brush and gray ink and  gray wash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in an indoor setting. In the foreground, a group of individuals dressed in robes are interacting near a central table or pulpit. A prominent figure stands to the right beside a large open book on a stand. The figures have distinct expressions and gestures. Some have short hair, while a couple have halo-like features around their heads. The background features architectural elements like arches and columns, with heavy drapery above. The image is monochromatic with intricate shading.

artworks.title: Geschrei (The Scream)
artworks.description: Printed in black on cream-white paper, a person standing on a bridge holds both hands to their oval-shaped head in this stylized lithograph. The person’s waifish body creates an S-shape, and their hollow eyes look slightly off to the left. The face has exaggeratedly high cheekbones, and the mouth is open in a tall oval. The bridge stretches from the bottom right corner of the print to the middle of the left edge of the sheet. Two black silhouettes represent people at the far end of the bridge. A curving form in the distance suggests a body of water with a couple of masted ships near the coastline. The rest of the landscape is carved with woodgrain-like, closely spaced, organic lines, and waves surge across the sky. A printed inscription in the margin below the image reads “Geschrei” and a pencil inscription in the lower right corner reads, “Edw Munch No 21.”
